subject: EdgeWorks co-sell demo — availability squeeze & final arbitration
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@edgeworks.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Ken Patel <k.patel@cloudbridge-sis.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: EdgeWorks × Redwood — co-sell demo availability

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — EdgeWorks is excited to align with Redwood for the joint marketplace demo. We want to get a technical co-sell session on the calendar with the AWS SI (CloudBridge) and our solutions engineering team.

Current constraints: CloudBridge has a narrow window next week (Aug 10-12) due to their APAC travel; EdgeWorks needs a US-friendly slot because our CTO will present. Can your team run a 45-minute live demo + 15-minute Q&A? Preferable times: 2026-08-11 10:00–11:00 ET or 2026-08-12 14:00–15:00 ET. If neither works, suggest 2 alternatives and we will triage.

Attached is our short demo brief (product highlights, expected audience). Please also confirm whether you can include a brief Marketplace listing walkthrough — our procurement wants to ensure listing and billing flow is covered.

Cheers,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Head of Partnerships, EdgeWorks

Attachment: edgeworks-demo-brief.pdf (PDF, 340KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@edgeworks.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Ken Patel <k.patel@cloudbridge-sis.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: EdgeWorks × Redwood — co-sell demo availability

Hi Sarah — thanks for the brief, looks great.

We can do a 60-minute run (45 + 15) but running it with CloudBridge + EdgeWorks + our SE requires a little calendar arbitration — our SE team has a scheduled all-hands on Aug 11 morning. Vanessa, can you confirm internal availability (and whether we can push an SE backup)?

If Aug 11 morning is off the table, I can offer:
- 2026-08-12 14:00–15:00 ET (matches your second option) — tentative for now
- 2026-08-13 11:00–12:00 ET — backup slot

Also looping in Vanessa so she can confirm marketplace demo ownership and prep the short walk-through Sarah requested. We'll attach our marketplace checklist and the HubSpot deal after we lock a time.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive — Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: EdgeWorks × Redwood — co-sell demo availability

Karthik / Sarah — thanks for the context. I can own the marketplace walkthrough portion; Ken from CloudBridge, please confirm if your lead can do the SI portion.

Quick logistics: CloudBridge's APAC travel means they have a single US window on Aug 12 afternoon PT (which is Aug 12 17:00–18:00 ET) — that's later than Sarah's suggested 14:00 ET and too late for our SEs on the east coast. To reconcile availability without losing the CloudBridge presence, propose the following arbitration:

- Option A (preferred): 2026-08-12 14:00–15:00 ET — Redwood SE joins remotely; CloudBridge sends a pre-recorded 10-min intro (we'll play it live) + live Q&A (Ken or a senior engineer joins the last 20 mins)
- Option B: 2026-08-13 11:00–12:00 ET — everyone live (full participation)

Operational asks if we choose Option A:
- Redwood SE to prepare a ~7-slide appendix for the Q&A (latency/cost numbers for EdgeWorks use case)
- Ken, please provide the pre-recorded intro by EOD Aug 10 (MP4) and any demo creds for sandbox access
- Karthik: confirm target audience (CTO + procurement + 2 product leads) so we can tune the demo

I'll mark Option A as tentative on my calendar.

—Vanessa
Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

One ask from CloudBridge procurement: please confirm the marketplace billing flow will be demoed (we need to call out subscriber entitlement mapping). If you can share the specific bullet points to cover, we'll include them in the video script.

All — thanks, this arbitration plan looks good. Final go from me for Option A (2026-08-12 14:00–15:00 ET) provided CloudBridge delivers the MP4 by EOD Aug 10 and Redwood SE appendix is ready by Aug 11 COB.

Neha: please note two operational callouts for the runbook:
- Add a one-slide SLA / support model callout for procurement (what we commit in a co-sell and who to escalate to)
- Ensure the marketplace listing flow is shown: buyer checkout -> fulfillment -> entitlement mapping. Vanessa, Karthik — include that in the agenda and prep notes.

Karthik — please confirm final attendee list so I can add the internal SE backup. I'll also attach the HubSpot deal and a link to the pre-demo checklist after this mail.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
